severity_policy.P0: Unsafe/wrong scored rule or key, corrupted acceptance/input, lost answer identity or release of held item; block every affected gate.
severity_policy.P1: Required content/route/runtime/accessibility unavailable, broken package/source dispatch or material approved-design/readability failure; block affected gates.
severity_policy.P2: Reproducible lesser correctness/usability/editorial defect; block its required acceptance case until fixed/retested or explicitly dispositioned under existing approved scope.
severity_policy.P3: Optional polish or new feature request; record separate scope, do not silently change approved design.
